hooks.name: Post-Session Diagnostics
hooks.description: After agent execution completes, runs getDiagnostics on the .rs files THIS session changed, and reports debug leftovers on lines it added. File selection and the leftover scan are done by .kiro/hooks/bin/session-diagnostics.sh, which compares content hashes against the SessionStart baseline; the agent is left only with getDiagnostics, which a script cannot call. The prompt used to do all of it by hand against `git diff --name-only HEAD` — the whole dirty tree, not the session — which on 2026-08-26 cost three consecutive Stop hooks a shell call plus up to ten getDiagnostics to conclude that nothing had changed. A quiet session now costs one shell call and no reasoning.

action.prompt:
Run `.kiro/hooks/bin/session-diagnostics.sh` and act only on what it prints.

- Prints nothing → say nothing. Do NOT run git, do NOT run getDiagnostics, do NOT comment on the tree.
- `RS_CHANGED: <paths>` → run getDiagnostics on exactly those paths. Report only errors and warnings; silence if clean.
- `LEFTOVER: …` → warn with the file and line. Do NOT auto-fix.

The script already scopes to this session and already scanned for debug macros. Do not re-derive either with your own git commands, and never run cargo build/clippy here.
